name: Miguel Alonso
summary: Spanish soldier and father of Giovanni Alfonso Borelli.

name: Laura Porella
summary: Mother of Giovanni Alfonso Borelli.

name: Benedetto Castelli
summary: Student of Galileo Galilei and teacher of Giovanni Alfonso Borelli.

name: Galileo Galilei
summary: Italian astronomer and physicist, indirect mentor to Borelli.

name: Ferdinando De' Medici
summary: Grand Duke of Tuscany who invited Borelli to the University of Pisa.

name: Christina of Sweden
summary: Queen of Sweden for whom Borelli served as personal medical consultant.

name: Marcello Malpighi
summary: Former pupil and collaborator of Borelli who continued his work on lungs.

name: Naples
summary: City in Italy where Borelli was born.

name: Rome
summary: City in Italy where Borelli studied and was later exiled.

name: Messina
summary: City in Sicily where Borelli lectured and returned to later.

name: Sicily
summary: Region in Italy where Messina is located.

name: Pisa
summary: City in Tuscany where the University of Pisa is located.

name: Tuscany
summary: Region in Italy ruled by Ferdinando De' Medici.

name: Italy
summary: Country where Borelli lived and worked.

name: University of Pisa
summary: University where Borelli was invited to work around 1655.

name: University of Messina
summary: University where Borelli lectured from 1635 to 1656.

name: Accademia della Fucina
summary: Scientific society in Messina that offered Borelli membership in 1635.

name: Accademia del Cimento
summary: Italian scientific society supported by Ferdinando De' Medici.

name: Scuola Normale Superiore
summary: Institution in Pisa holding Borelli's original manuscripts.

summary: Organization founded in 1977 that bestows the Borelli Award.

summary: Borelli's masterpiece on biomechanics published posthumously.
